sourceEvidence.title: Automotive Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressive experience in quality, manufacturing, supplier quality, or engineering preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex problem-solving and corrective-action initiatives.
* Previous supervisory, team leadership, or project leadership experience strongly preferred.
